Gemini is looking for a Senior Product Designer to join their Prediction Markets team, a hybrid role based in their New York City office. This individual will be responsible for shaping product strategy and defining user journeys across both retail and institutional products within the dynamic crypto FinTech sector. The role necessitates close collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, and other design professionals to develop scalable and intuitive experiences, transforming user research into refined designs, and overseeing the entire design execution process from initial concept development through prototyping and user testing. In-person collaboration at the NYC office is required twice weekly.

**Core Responsibilities:**
*   Define and shape product strategy as well as user journeys for retail and institutional products.
*   Collaborate extensively with Product Management, Engineering, and design colleagues to create scalable product experiences.
*   Translate insights gained from user research into elegant and functional design solutions.
*   Take ownership of the end-to-end design execution, encompassing concept generation, prototyping, and testing phases.
*   Participate in required in-person collaboration sessions at the New York City office twice per week.

**Requirements:**
*   Demonstrated experience in product design at a senior level.
*   Proven ability to craft and deliver scalable user experiences.
*   Proficiency in translating user research findings into effective design.
*   Strong skills in concept development, prototyping, and user testing.
*   Prior experience in the crypto FinTech industry is considered a significant advantage.
